description: Find Nova Poshta branches and parcel lockers in a Ukrainian city where an AkulaCyber order can be delivered, from the directory the checkout uses. If the city name matches several places, the result lists them; call again with city_ref. At most 30 points are returned; more_points true means the city has more, so narrow with query (a point number or a street). Delivery terms come with the result.

city_ref.description: Nova Poshta city ref from an earlier result.

lang.description: Language of the answer: uk (Ukrainian), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language of the user.

query.description: Branch or locker number, or part of the address.

type.description: branch for Nova Poshta branches, locker for parcel lockers, all for both.

name: akulacyber_find_delivery_points
title: Find Nova Poshta delivery points
